text:
lisa (Partnerships): quick heads-up — i'm drafting the playbook for the partner band rename + how we split MDF buckets for the next QBR. need input from finance and sales before i lock the slides.

sam (Field Sales): +1. can we ensure SI integrators get a separate MDF carveout? they drive long deals and need implementation credits.

ana (Partner Ops): noted. current idea: three MDF buckets — Enablement, Co-marketing, SI Implementation. rough splits: 40/30/30.

kevin (Finance): 40/30/30 seems fine as a starting point. we should add a guardrail: no single partner >25% of a bucket unless approved. @lisa can you add that as a policy item?

lisa (Partnerships): yes — will add the cap. also thinking to rename tiers from "Premier/Strategic/Standard" to "Band A/Band B/Band C" to reduce implication of exclusivity. thoughts?

viv (Partner Marketing): i like "Band" naming — easier for marketplace listing and simpler in collateral. need to update the joint-announcement checklist though (assets, legal signoff, launch email cadence).

sam (Field Sales): one ask — sales should get a faster review lane for partner-approved co-marketing requests. backlog kills momentum. can partner ops own a 48-hour SRP?

ana (Partner Ops): we can pilot a 48-hour review for high-touch deals; will need a small intake form + SLAs. i'll draft the intake fields and post tomorrow.

kevin (Finance): for budgeting: propose we hold a 10% contingency from total MDF to cover emergency top-ups and marketplace promotions. log any exceptions.

qbr-bot: reminder — QBR assets due in 6 days. upload to /shared/partnerships/qbr/ if ready.

lisa (Partnerships): thanks all. action items: ana drafts intake + SLA, viv updates announcement checklist, kevin confirms contingency wording, sam documents faster review lane. i'll assemble the slide deck and circulate by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
